case.summary: Case CASE-015 (Card SC-03015-K952): The investigation was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.82 on transaction 4012177 ($194.42, domestic) [EV-8521f876]. The card (SC-03015-K952) showed two prior transactions averaging $129.53 [EV-aff470be] and three online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-2586d295]. The flagged transaction originated from a device marked 'New' for this account (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) [EV-37615a0d] and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-ef1be3ea]. The customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4323) [EV-3e7e72cb], and the same device profile appears in one confirmed fraud case [EV-5b209d10]. Six prior closed cases share the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern [EV-67949392]. The customer denied making the purchases and confirmed physical possession of the card [EV-c3e04c14].

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report covers CASE-015, closed with a fraud verdict under the card_not_present_new_device pattern. The investigation identified three affected transactions (4012177, 4012178, 4012179) totaling $453.49 in exposure. The initial alert came from a real-time model scoring transaction 4012177 at 0.82 [EV-8521f876]. Transaction analysis revealed a new device fingerprint (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) not previously associated with the account [EV-37615a0d] and an anonymous proxy connection routing through Argentina [EV-ef1be3ea]. Velocity checks showed three online transactions within a 48-hour window [EV-2586d295], deviating from the card's historical average of $129.53 over two prior transactions [EV-aff470be]. The customer (SC-03015) has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4323) [EV-3e7e72cb], and the device profile has been linked to another confirmed fraud case [EV-5b209d10]. Pattern retrieval returned six prior cases with the same card_not_present_new_device signature [EV-67949392]. The cardholder reported no authorization of the transactions and confirmed the physical card remained in their possession [EV-c3e04c14]. Based on the convergence of new device, proxy usage, velocity anomaly, prior fraud history, and customer denial, the case was substantiated as fraud.
